thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident fired: PRIVATE-CP-VPC-CONN (sev: high) for customer AcmeCorp — private control plane connectivity failing. Trigger: healthcheck 502 from control-plane agent. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident INC12345 created and notified on-call(s). Escalation policy: private-infra.

mike_ops: acked the pager via PagerDuty — taking initial lead.

sara_oncall: Thanks Mike — are we seeing agent heartbeats dropped or full control-plane unreachable? Any customer impact metrics?

daniel_sre: Attaching quick triage notes. From control-plane logs around 16:02 UTC:
```
2026-03-10T16:02:11Z control-plane[api] WARN failed healthcheck: upstream tcp connect timeout to 10.4.0.2:8443
2026-03-10T16:02:12Z control-plane[proxy] ERROR connection reset by peer
```

Also query from the private agent shows repeated TLS handshake timeouts. Running curl from control-plane to agent IP fails with ECONNREFUSED.

mike_ops: Customer support pinged: AcmeCorp reported ~3% of inference requests returned 503s starting 16:00 UTC — no broad latency spike but increased error rate on private deployment.

amy_net: I'm pulling VPC peering and BGP state now. Quick checks:
- cloud console shows two VPN tunnels for AcmeCorp; tunnel-1 BGP is down, tunnel-2 up but flapping.
- Route table still has control-plane route via tunnel-1 which is DOWN.

net commands I ran:
```
# on our side
show bgp neighbors 10.1.1.1
BGP neighbor 10.1.1.1 state: Idle (last update 16:01:53)

# traceroute from control-plane -> agent
traceroute to 10.4.0.2 (10.4.0.2), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.2.0.1  1.0 ms  1.1 ms  1.0 ms
 2  * * *
 3  203.0.113.45  15.6 ms  15.4 ms  15.5 ms
```

It looks like an intermediate provider link dropped and BGP didn't failover cleanly.

sara_oncall: Good catch. Mike, can you open a direct ticket with the cloud provider and request BGP adjacency and tunnel health check? Include traceroute and timestamps. I'll prepare customer-facing note.

mike_ops: Opening ticket now — PD created: CLD-98765. Notified provider NOC with logs and BGP neighbor dump. Also temporarily re-routed control-plane traffic through standby region (will increase latency).

john_support: Sent AcmeCorp an interim status message: "We're investigating connectivity to your private control plane; mitigation in progress. We'll update within 30 mins." They confirmed they see degraded responses.

daniel_sre: While provider responds, short-term mitigation steps we executed:
- Removed broken route that pinned traffic to tunnel-1
- Installed route via tunnel-2 (standby) and forced BGP reset on our side: `bgp soft-reconfig in` then `clear bgp neighbor 10.1.1.1`
- Restarted on-prem agent process (graceful) to re-establish TLS sessions.

Command outputs:
```
# after forcing reset
BGP neighbor 10.1.1.1 state: Established (up for 00:02:12)
Control-plane -> agent TLS handshake: success
agent-heartbeat: last_seen=2026-03-10T16:09:12Z
```

mike_ops: Provider acked the ticket — they confirmed a transit flapping event and restarted the provider router. BGP adjacency now stable on their end.

amy_net: Seeing routes converge. Control-plane pod logs show sustained connectivity. Heartbeats back to normal.

sara_oncall: Customer update sent: "We have applied a temporary route and your control plane connectivity is restored. Our provider reported a transit flap and we've stabilized sessions. We'll work on making the failover more robust and will follow up with a postmortem." :white_check_mark:

john_support: AcmeCorp replied: "Thanks, we see requests succeeding again. Please inform when full RCA is available."

daniel_sre: Status check at 16:27 UTC:
- agent heartbeats: normal (last_seen < 1m)
- error rate: back to baseline
- control-plane healthchecks: passing

sara_oncall: I'm going to hand this over to Mike for monitoring and postmortem follow-up. I'm off in ~10m.

mike_ops: Got it. I'll keep monitoring for 2 hours and then schedule the postmortem with net and infra teams. I'll collect BGP dumps, traceroutes, and the timeline.

incident-bot: Incident INC12345 status changed to RESOLVED by mike_ops (resolution: provider transit flap, failover applied). PagerDuty incident closed.

mike_ops: Post-incident actions (will create tasks):
- run controlled failover test for AcmeCorp routing (owner: amy_net)
- add healthcheck-based automatic route failover in control-plane (owner: daniel_sre)
- update runbook for private VPC control-plane paging to include forced route change steps and contact template for provider ticketing (owner: sara_oncall)

sara_oncall: Thanks everyone. I'll add customer follow-up items to the ticket. Leaving handoff note in #oncall-handoffs. :wave:

mike_ops: Closing loop — monitoring shows stable for 36m. Leaving incident thread open for 24h for any regressions.

pagerduty: Incident INC12345 closed at 1893451642.

incident-bot: Automated postmortem reminder scheduled for 2026-03-11T10:00:00Z.
